name: CoorHexagon
comment: Returns 6 vertices of a hexagon centered at (x0, y0). Argument order is circumDiameter, x0, y0. circumDiameter is the vertex-to-vertex diameter. The first vertex is at angle 0 on the positive x-axis, then every 60 degrees counterclockwise, so the hexagon is flat on the top and bottom. The first vertex is not repeated. Non-numeric input returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
